title: Abyssals v0.90.41 — Pride, Wrath and Type Eggs
notes: Major original Pride and weapon-based Wrath redesigns, with the original Flaskling visibly present in all four sin forms and matching walking sprites. Cleans sixteen item icons and adds six broad held items to the Exchange. Reggifox’s unique The Fixer ability now prepares stronger special attacks after status moves, entirely in singles. Arthox gains Parting Blow, a Fighting damaging switch move in the catalogue. Adds all eighteen type egg designs: each shell half shows one hatchling type, including existing eggs. Preserves hatch outcomes, saves, permanent deaths, quests, package identity and original signing certificate. Includes updated offline PWA.
